blocks.title: A browser your agent can really use
blocks.description: Ego is a Chromium browser built for people and agents together. With this plugin, Vetta reaches for it whenever a task needs a real browser — your signed-in sites, rendered pages, forms and screenshots included.

showcase.user_prompt: I changed the checkout form. Open the dev server in ego and make sure it still works.
showcase.assistant_reply: Opened localhost:3000 in ego and ran the checkout with a test card. Verified: totals update, and an empty email shows a validation error. Broken: the Pay button stays disabled after fixing a bad card number — screenshot attached. Not tested: the 3-D Secure step.

items.title: Default for browser work
items.description: Whenever a task needs a real browser, Vetta uses ego first and falls back only when it must.

items.title: Works with your signed-in sites
items.description: The agent uses your existing sessions instead of asking you for passwords.

items.title: Fills, clicks and captures
items.description: Open pages, fill forms, click through flows, take screenshots and pull data out of rendered pages.

items.title: Tests your web app
items.description: Point it at a local dev server or a staging site and have it walk a flow like a user would.

items.title: Install ego lite
items.description: Download it from lite.ego.app and finish its first-run setup. If it is missing, the agent will walk you through it.

items.title: Ask for browser work
items.description: Describe the site or flow in a conversation.

blocks.content: Ego acts inside your real, signed-in browser profile. Start with read-only checks, and tell the agent to ask you first before it submits, buys or deletes anything.
